---
title: "Mi app con ShinyLive"
format: html
filters:
  - shinylive
---

```{r}
#| standalone: true

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Ejemplo ShinyLive"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput(
        "n",
        "Cantidad de datos:",
        min = 10,
        max = 1000,
        value = 100
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("hist")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  output$hist <- renderPlot({
    hist(rnorm(input$n))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
